observation.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
CSRF=$(grep -o 'name="_csrf_token" value="[^"]*"' step1.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -e "http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap" --max-time 10 \
  -d "_csrf_token=$CSRF" -d "instance_name=localhost" \
  -o step1_resp.html -w "step1 POST: [%{http_code}]\n" http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap/step/1
head -c 200 step1_resp.html; echo
